description: This file contains an abstract class 'FieldCodecTester' used for testing serialization codecs within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for verifying correct serialization, deserialization, buffer handling, and reference counting, primarily for unit testing with Xunit.

classes.name: FieldCodecTester
classes.description: An abstract class providing a comprehensive suite of unit tests for serialization codecs, including buffer handling, reference counting, and round-trip serialization tests within the Orleans serialization framework.

methods.name: CorrectlyAdvancesReferenceCounterStream
methods.description: Verifies that writing and reading a value correctly updates the reference counter in the serialization session when using streams.

methods.name: CorrectlyAdvancesReferenceCounter
methods.description: Verifies that writing and reading a value correctly updates the reference counter when using pipes.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer_StreamPooled
methods.description: Tests that a value can be serialized and deserialized correctly using a pooled stream.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer_Span
methods.description: Tests that a value can be serialized and deserialized correctly using a span.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer_Array
methods.description: Tests that a value can be serialized and deserialized correctly using a byte array.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer_Memory
methods.description: Tests that a value can be serialized and deserialized correctly using a Memory<byte>.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer_MemoryStream
methods.description: Tests that a value can be serialized and deserialized correctly using a MemoryStream.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer_ReadByteByByte
methods.description: Simulates fragmented reads to verify that serialization and deserialization work correctly when reading byte-by-byte.

methods.name: ProducesValidBitStream
methods.description: Verifies that the serialized output produces a valid bit stream that can be formatted.

methods.name: WritersProduceSameResults
methods.description: Ensures that different buffer writers produce identical serialized results for the same value.

methods.name: CanRoundTripCollectionViaSerializer
methods.description: Verifies that a list of values can be serialized and deserialized correctly.

methods.name: CanRoundTripWeaklyTypedCollectionViaSerializer
methods.description: Verifies that a list of objects can be serialized and deserialized correctly.

methods.name: CanRoundTripTupleViaSerializer
methods.description: Verifies that a tuple containing values can be serialized and deserialized correctly.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer
methods.description: Verifies that a value can be serialized and deserialized correctly using the default serializer.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaObjectSerializer
methods.description: Verifies that a value can be serialized and deserialized correctly using the object serializer.

methods.name: RoundTrippedValuesEqual
methods.description: Checks that a value, after round-trip serialization, remains equal to the original.

methods.name: CanRoundTripDefaultValueViaCodec
methods.description: Verifies that default values can be round-tripped correctly.

methods.name: CanSkipValue
methods.description: Tests that a value can be skipped during deserialization.

methods.name: CanSkipDefaultValue
methods.description: Tests that default values can be skipped during deserialization.

methods.name: CorrectlyHandlesBuffers
methods.description: Verifies buffer handling and deserialization correctness across various buffer types and segment sizes.

methods.name: CanBeSkipped
methods.description: Helper method to verify skipping over a value during deserialization.

methods.name: TestRoundTrippedValue
methods.description: Helper method to verify that a value can be serialized and deserialized correctly.

methods.name: RoundTripThroughCodec
methods.description: Serializes and deserializes a value through a codec, verifying correctness.

methods.name: RoundTripThroughUntypedSerializer
methods.description: Serializes and deserializes a value through an untyped serializer, returning the deserialized object and formatted bit stream.
